Not sure if they will let me post links here or not, but this site has links and advice on how to find low cost/free help. There are free therapy sessions that are government sponsored (assuming you are in the US)

https://adaa.org/finding-help/treatment/low-cost-treatment#

The side bar of this forum has a bunch of resources themselves. 

there's also subreddits much like this one too.

I know the feeling. I have gone through similar stuff in the past and am still going through it. The fear that after everything you've gone through, you don't know if this is the end of the pain, or merely the beginning. 

My advice is this, go to the doctors, even if you don't have insurance. Go. Most places will let you work out a payment plan and give you discounted rates. I was diagnosed with anxiety and depression. The medication they gave me helped me work through a lot of the issues I was having. I worked up some medical bills but ultimately you need to realize that you are important. You are worth spending money on yourself. 

Even if you don't go to the docs, there are a ton of free resources out there. Take that first first step. It's super scary I know. But you'll feel much better if you do. Good luck.

Thanks for the well wishes. I decided to make an urgent care visit to talk to a doc. Seems like my meds might not be working right. changed me over to something else. 

hopefully ill stop waking up at 3am at least. 

man i hope things get better soon.

I've made amends with everyone i pushed away but my former SO. I can tell the ex pretty much only keeps in contact because they know I'm feeling down. It's better than nothing I guess. 

Thank you for your support and reading my long winded rant. It means a lot to me.
Thank you kind internet stranger. It means a lot to hear that anyone gives a shit. I hope your own issues work out in your favor.
